question:
**Direction: A part of the given sentence which has been underlined may contain a spelling error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the spelling error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The doctor prescribed to put the patient in **__quarrantine__** for a few days.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Quarantine.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The spelling of the given word '**quarrantine**' is **INCORRECT.**
